Kensaku is a fast, local-first desktop search application built with Rust and Tauri. It allows users to quickly find files by name, content within documents and images (via OCR), and even by semantic meaning. It also integrates with AI agents through the MCP protocol, prioritizing user privacy as nothing leaves the local machine.

ffmpeg-skill provides a local, offline video editing environment for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. It offers 42 FFmpeg-based tools accessible via a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, enabling agents to perform tasks such as cutting, adding captions, reframing, and loudness normalization without relying on cloud services or API keys.
